Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted “older director” and compared the directors’ ages at their films’ release years (37 vs 31) instead of their absolute ages (birth years). With Don McGuire born in 1919 and Nunzio Malasomma in 1894, Malasomma is older, so the correct film is One Minute to Twelve; the Planner incorrectly concluded Johnny Concho.
